R. 561-1 (25% threshold); Code de commerce arts. L. 123-9-1 and R. 123-109 (mandatory UBO declaration filed with the RCS); Décret n° 2016-1848 of 28 December 2016 (as amended) transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 and Directive (EU) 2018/843; Loi n° 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); CJEU joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20, WM and Sovim SA (limiting public access to beneficial ownership data); Règlement (UE) 2015/847 (funds transfer traceability); Règlement (UE) 2018/1805 (mutual recognition of freezing and confiscation orders).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry of the parent company's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the UN Security Council consolidated lists, EU consolidated financial sanctions list (Council Regulation (EU) No 2023/1528 and related implementing acts), French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor) asset-freeze lists, and the FATF high-risk and non-cooperative jurisdictions list; OFAC screening is required as a matter of French banking practice for any USD-denominated wire or letter of credit under the target payment rails. PEP identification follows Cod monétaire et financier arts. L. 561-10 and R. 561-12, including beneficial owners of foreign public functions, immediate family, and known close associates; any positive PEP match triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification, senior management escalation, and filing of a declaration to TRACFIN under art. L. 561-15 where suspicion arises.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique électronique des formalités d'entreprises (procedures.inpi.fr), cross-checked against the Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) and Infogreffe/RCS records
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name of a SARL must be expressed in the French language in accordance with Loi n° 94-665 of 4 August 1994 (Loi Toubon); foreign technical or accepted terms with no French equivalent (e.g., 'biosimilar') may be retained, but any non-Latin script (CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic, etc.) must be transliterated into the Latin alphabet for registration in the RNE; the statutory mention 'Société à Responsabilité Limitée' or initialism 'SARL' and the registered share capital must appear immediately after or before the name on all corporate documents.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon an INPI/RCS name-refusal notification: (1) obtain the reasoned refusal from the INPI guichet unique and the relevant greffe; (2) run a comparative RNE, Infogreffe, and INPI trademark search to identify the conflicting registration; (3) if the conflict is unresolvable, immediately propose an alternative compliant designator to the client and refile the complete incorporation dossier within the 30-day reservation window; (4) where the ground of refusal is a regulated token (e.g., 'laboratoire pharmaceutique' or 'banque'), initiate the prior authorization application with ANSM (manufacturing authorization under Code de la santé publique art. L. 5124-2) or ACPR (for banking/insurance terms) before refiling; (5) if the applicant contests the refusal as arbitrary, lodge a recours gracieux with the INPI Director-General within two months of notification, followed by a recours contentieux before the Tribunal administratif de Paris within two months of an express or implicit rejection; (6) meanwhile, file a trademark application with INPI to secure a priority date for the chosen name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole business location for a biopharmaceutical manufacturer: ANSM manufacturing authorization and physically inspectable GMP premises are mandatory under Code de la santé publique arts. L. 5124-2 et seq. A domiciliation company is accepted for the registered office only under Code de commerce art. L. 123-11-1, provided the bioreactor fermentation and purification site is a separate, declared, licensed address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Post-licensing: 90-100% probability of annual or biennial ANSM/EMA GMP surveillance inspections, including unannounced inspections at high-risk biological manufacturing sites; pre-incorporation office-only inspection: 5-15% probability of an administrative identity check.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark subscription and per-subject screening fee for a High-Risk Biopharma entity

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II, Title II, Articles L.223-1 through L.223-43 (SARL); Articles L.210-1 through L.210-10 (formation publicity and validity); implemented by the Guichet unique procedure of Décret nᵒ 2023-266
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) kept by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; filings are submitted electronically through the INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de création d'entreprise (centralised dematerialised filing with the Guichet unique) resulting in an RCS immatriculation and delivery of the extrait K-bis
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: French law imposes no statutory minimum share capital for an SARL; the capital is freely fixed in the articles. Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked account opened in the SARL's name with a licensed French bank, the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, or a notary. At least one-fifth of the cash contributions must be paid up before filing, and the balance may be paid up in one or more instalments within five years of RCS registration; the deposit must remain blocked until the K-bis certificate is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: It is RESOLVED that the incorporators hereby subscribe and fully allocate the share capital of this Société à Responsabilité Limitée in accordance with the draft Articles of Association. RESOLVED FURTHER that all cash contributions be deposited in a blocked account maintained with a licensed French credit institution or a notary until the completed registration certificate is issued by the Registry of Commerce and Companies. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office be fixed at [address] and that the named General Manager is appointed, accepting the powers, duties and signature authorization stated in the Articles of Association. RESOLVED FINALLY that the proposed Articles of Association, the manager's declaration of no disqualification and this resolution are approved for immediate electronic filing with the Guichet unique.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Clear the corporate name and verify sectoral prerequisites
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI/Guichet unique and RCS name-search database (infogreffe); consultation with the French Health Products Agency (ANSM) optional
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the desired legal name against the RCS database in the intended department to avoid confusion with existing trademarks or RCS registrations; confirm that the planned object covers bioreactor fermentation and purification of biosimilar antibodies; if the facility requires a pharmaceutical establishment licence, hold a pre-filing consultation with ANSM and list the conditions applicable under Public Health Code Articles L.4211-1 and L.5124-1.
required_dossiers: Draft corporate name and company-formation form details
Identification of incorporators and general manager
List of existing trademarks or entity names searched
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable, immediately file a revised name or add distinctive material; no national name-reservation stage is available, proceed directly to filing once cleared.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit cash capital into a blocked French bank account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed French credit institution or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations for the future SARL; alternatively a notary may hold the funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the SARL in formation; deposit the cash contributions; the bank issues a certificate of deposit of funds confirming the amount and the blocked nature; the certificate must mention the entity name and the future RCS registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
Passport or national identity document of each subscriber and manager
Beneficial-ownership and tax status information
Source-of-funds statement and KYC declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced know-your-customer checks because of the biopharmaceutical senior-risk business, supply audited founding shareholder statements or a justificatif de patrimoine; if refusal persists, use the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations and close the account after registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding associates and legal counsel; notary required where an in-kind contribution of immovable property is made
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles under Code de commerce Articles L.223-1 et seq., adding the exact corporate purpose for manufacture of monoclonal antibody biosimilars; determine share capital, allocation to subscribers, registered office, manager identity and powers, duration and dispute-resolution clauses; sign all copies and annex the manager's acceptance.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Association
Statement of each manager's identity and nationality
Document proving ownership or right to use the registered office
Notarised deed if real estate is contributed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry notes omissions, execute a rectificatif (amending resolution) signed by all members; if in-kind contribution requires the intervention of a commissaire aux apports, appoint the statutory capital auditor before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Approved Journal d'annonces légales in the département of the registered office; the journal must be formally authorised by the Prefecture
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Place a formal notice of incorporation containing the exact corporate name, legal form, amount and composition of capital, registered office address, corporate object, duration, manager name and the future RCS application number; request a justificatif de parution for filing.
required_dossiers: Draft legal-announcement text
Proof of payment to the journal
Justificatif de parution after publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice is refused due to incomplete data, correct and republish on the same or following day; ensure the journal holds the five-year legal-announcements authorization issued by the Prefecture.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the incorporation dossier with the Guichet unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises, electronically transmitted to the RCS of the competent commercial court
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the dematerialised portal, select 'SARL' and complete the company-creation declaration; upload the statutory papers, signatory consents, declaration of manager non-disqualification, proof of registered office, bank deposit certificate, legal-announcement receipt and pay the official fee; upon validation, the RCS will review the file and then issue the K-bis registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Completed centralised company-creation form through Guichet unique
Copy of signed Articles of Association
Proof of registered office (address and supporting lease or domiciliation contract)
Identity document of each shareholder and manager
Certificate of deposit of capital from the bank or notary
Justificatif de parution from the legal-announcement journal
Declaration by the manager of no criminal disqualification
Original power of attorney for each signatory, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query (instance décompte), respond within the fifteen-day electronic filing window; supply missing documents or corrective declarations; if refused, request review by the registrar and, after exhaustion, apply to the competent judicial authority for RCS conflicts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain the RCS registration certificate and INSEE identifiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / RCS; INSEE automatically transmits SIREN, SIRET and APE codes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the formalities are complete, the Greffe delivers the extrait K-bis enrolling the company in the RCS and conferring full legal personality; confirm the SIREN, SIRET and APE code aligned with pharmaceutical manufacture and the VAT number notification from the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques.
required_dossiers: K-bis extract delivered by the Greffe
INSEE notification of SIREN and SIRET
Provisional VAT number certificate from DGFiP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the K-bis contains an error, use an RCS rectificative filing through the Guichet unique to correct the legal form, corporate object or manager data; the correction is retroactive to the original registration date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate books and register as employer with tax and social administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques, DREETS, and the Greffe for statutory books
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the mandatory share register and minute books; register the manager for social security and obtain the URSSAF enterprise number; apply for the intra-community VAT number and register VAT under the SARL's SIRET; notify DGFiP of the effective date of activity and the registered office; maintain minutes of the first shareholders' meeting.
required_dossiers: K-bis
RCS certificate of appointment of manager
VAT number application
URSSAF employer registration form
Registered-office lease or invoice showing SIRET
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If forms are rejected because the SIRET is not yet available, wait for the INSEE notification prior to filing; if registrations are late, submit a spontaneous regularization statement to URSSAF and DGFiP to limit penalties.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM) - Direction de l'évaluation des médicaments
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licence d'établissement pharmaceutique pour la fabrication, l'importation et l'exploitation de médicaments biologiques et biosimilaires, issued under Articles L.5124-1 et seq. of the French Public Health Code

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL), Ministère de la Transition Écologique
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Installation classée pour la protection de l'environnement (ICPE), rubrique 2611 (pharmaceutical manufacturing), submitted under the authorization regime with a full environmental impact assessment report and mandatory public inquiry under Code de l'environnement Articles L.181-1 and R.122-2
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The establishment must comply with the applicable Best Available Techniques conclusions under Directive 2010/75/EU; volatile organic compound emissions, bio-aerosols and odours must be abated to the thresholds fixed in the individual prefectural authorization; process wastewater must be decontaminated before discharge and meet the numeric limits for COD, BOD5, total suspended solids and priority hazardous substances specified in the ICPE authorization; biological and pharmaceutical hazardous waste must be sterilized, tracked and transferred to a licensed waste-treatment chain.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification from the Departmental Fire and Rescue Service (SDIS) and the Préfecture's commission de sécurité; structural-load compliance certificate from an approved design office; workplace clearance from DREETS under the Code du travail; occupational-health surveillance by a workplace physician for staff handling biologics; ICPE inspection confirms both environmental and occupational compliance before production start-up.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) — French national tax authority. Main portals: impots.gouv.fr (corporate tax and VAT returns), formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet unique for company incorporation and registrations) and pro.douane.gouv.fr / DELTA (customs declaration system for export VAT evidence). Non-resident taxpayers without a French establishment are handled by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises Étrangères (SIEE), Paris.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French-incorporated SARL: file incorporation formalities through the Guichet unique portal; INSEE automatically allocates SIREN and SIRET identifiers; DGFiP allocates the French intra-Community VAT number in the format FR + 2-digit key + 9-digit SIREN. Foreign entity without a permanent establishment: apply to the SIEE on Form SD 8471 (if established in the EU) or SD 8473 (if established outside the EU), enclosing certified articles of association, certificate of incorporation, proof of fiscal domicile, and a power of attorney in favour of the appointed tax representative (a fiscal representative is compulsory for non-EU established entities); the SIEE then grants a French intra-Community VAT number and activates the impots.gouv.fr professional account.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — The SARL is by default subject to French corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés) at a 25% standard rate, with a reduced rate of 15% on the first €42,500 of annual taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (turnover below €10 million). The SARL does not benefit from automatic pass-through taxation; a French branch of a foreign company is equally taxed at entity level on its French-source profits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (1) An SARL whose shareholders are exclusively natural persons may elect for partnership-type transparency under Article 239 bis AA CGI for a five-year period; (2) a single-member EURL with an individual shareholder may likewise opt to be taxed in the personal income tax regime; (3) corporate groups holding at least 95% of a French subsidiary may elect tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under Article 223 A CGI; (4) ATAD 1/2 hybrid mismatch rules codified in Articles 229 to 239 quinquies CGI restrict hybrid instruments and hybrid permanent establishment mismatches; no US-style check-the-box election exists under French law.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (TVA — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée), governed by Articles 256 to 293 of the French General Tax Code (CGI) and implemented under Council Directive 2006/112/EC.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Non-established foreign suppliers: nil threshold — VAT registration is mandatory as of the first taxable supply of goods or services in France, subject to reverse-charge relief for certain B2B imported services under Article 283 CGI where the French customer self-assesses VAT. Resident SMEs may use the franchise en base de TVA up to €93,500 per year for sales of goods and €37,500 per year for services (2025 thresholds); the franchise is not available to an SARL that has opted for IS or to foreign suppliers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured e-invoicing and e-reporting are phased in through the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) and certified dematerialisation platforms (PDPs). From 1 September 2026, all VAT-registered businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices, and large and mid-size enterprises must issue structured e-invoices (Factur-X, UBL, CII) and transmit e-reporting of transaction and payment data. From 1 September 2027, small and micro businesses, including a typical SARL, must issue fully structured e-invoices. France does not operate real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping; e-reporting must be transmitted to DGFiP within 10 days of invoice issuance through the PPF or a certified PDP.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods outside the EU qualify for 0% VAT under Article 262-I CGI provided the goods are physically transported out of France and the exporter holds documentary evidence; intra-EU dispatches of goods to a taxable customer are exempt under Article 262 ter CGI where the purchaser's intra-Community VAT number is validated, the DES/EC sales list is filed, and transport to another Member State is proven. Services physically performed on goods to be exported are zero-rated under Article 262-1° CGI; B2B services supplied to non-French entrepreneurs are outside French VAT under Article 259-1° CGI if the customer is established abroad. Biosimilar monoclonal antibody production for export accordingly benefits from 0% VAT treatment on cross-border supplies, while French domestic sales remain taxable at 20%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (EX-E) lodged through the DELTA system and the DPE/DEB summary declaration
Transport evidence: original Bill of Lading (B/L), Air Waybill (AWB) or CMR consignment note evidencing physical dispatch from France
Commercial invoice, sales contract, packing list and inward remittance certificate or SWIFT MT103 bank credit evidence
For intra-EU dispatch: the customer's validated intra-Community VAT ID and the DES (Déclaration d'Échange de Biens) record
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP and French Customs cross-check export declarations against VAT returns, the EC Sales List/DES and bank payment flows. If zero-rating is disallowed, VAT at 20% is clawed back under Article 1788 A CGI, together with late-payment interest at 0.20% per month (Article 1727 CGI) and penalties of 40% for insufficient declarations or 80% for deliberate misstatement or abuse of rights (Articles 1729-1730 CGI). False customs declarations connected with exports may trigger criminal sanctions under Articles 414-415 of the French Customs Code, including fines up to twice the VAT amount in issue and confiscation of the goods. Export substantiation documents must be retained for six years, and refunds already credited can be retrospectively reassessed.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France together with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury, Ministry for the Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty); banking conduct and AML/CFT supervision by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) under the Code Monétaire et Financier (CMF).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully and freely convertible. France has liberalised both current-account and capital-account payments since Law No. 88-1201 of 23 December 1988; dividend and profit remittances, shareholder loan repayments, interest, royalties and trade settlements are not subject to FX licensing or convertibility ceilings. Residual operational hurdles are AML/KYC documentation, EU and national sanctions screening, FATCA/CRS reporting, and, for a bio-health manufacturer acquiring critical infrastructure exposure, prior foreign-investment approval under Article L.151-3 paragraph IV CMF. An SARL may remit dividends without FX permission once the annual accounts are approved, subject to corporate-law solvency tests and applicable dividend withholding rules; no treasury drain results from currency-transfer restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio for export proceeds in France. Exporters may retain receivables in any currency, maintain foreign-currency accounts domestically or abroad, and convert at market rates without restriction. The only residual duty is statistical: cross-border payments connected with exports and receivables must be captured in the Banque de France balance-of-payments data collection system, either automatically through the resident payment bank or via direct monthly declaration when amounts exceed the applicable notification threshold. No repatriation deadline or conversion period applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency operating account (EUR/USD) plus dedicated capital escrow/blocked account for shareholder subscriptions
Commercial operating account with trade finance and documentary letter-of-credit desk; USD correspondent clearing in New York

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. / Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Regional commercial account aggregated with CIB treasury services and escrow facility for paid-in capital

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: CIC Crédit Industriel et Commercial / Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale

Wholesale treasury account and hedging line coordinated with Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne group

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low for primary treasury infrastructure; at best a secondary disbursement channel. An offshore digital EMI that is not authorised in an EEA jurisdiction may not lawfully provide payment accounts to French residents on a passporting basis, and UK EMIs lost passporting rights after Brexit. EEA-licensed EMIs are supervised but typically lack SWIFT correspondent banking, MT103 trade-wire capability, documentary credit issuance and Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting features. Given the High_Risk_Special_License classification of biosimilar manufacturing, French Tier-1 banks will not extend full AML reliance to an EMI-only setup; a regulated Tier-1 or Tier-2 bank mandate is mandatory for structural liquidity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical, face-to-face KYC interview is the de facto market standard for a foreign-owned pharmaceutical SARL. French law admits remote identification under Article L.561-5-1-1 CMF through ACPR-certified electronic identity verification, but for the ISIC 2100 biosimilar manufacturer banks apply enhanced due diligence requiring at least one in-person meeting at the French branch or registered office with the legal representative, each director, and each 25-percent-plus beneficial owner. Remote opening solely by videoconference is technically permissible but will in practice be declined by the principal Tier-1 banks unless a verified track record, pre-existing group banking relationship or private-bank guarantee package is provided.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk industry classification (ISIC 2100 pharmaceutical/biologics manufacturing) and statutory licence requirement flagged at first customer-relationship touchpoint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full bundle comprising the ANSM manufacturing authorisation issued under Article L.5124-2 of the French Public Health Code, EU Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP/BPF) certificate or recent inspection letter, establishment and premises licence, biosafety and waste-handling permits, site-visit presentation pack covering cGMP bioreactor and purification suites, and the current quality-management-system certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EEA upstream ownership chain with intermediate holding companies and reputational risk of opaque cross-border flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory UBO register extraction under Article L.561-2-2 CMF; full corporate organigram to ultimate individuals; certificate of incorporation, board minutes and audited financial statements of each intermediate legal entity; CRS and FATCA self-certifications; independent source-of-wealth report from a recognised auditor; and bank references covering the intermediate treasury accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Early-stage SARL with high expected transaction velocity relative to share capital and no observable payment footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twenty-four-month audited cash-flow and liquidity plan; signed raw-material supply contracts and offtake agreements that justify the expected payment tickets; commercial-invoice and bill-of-lading mapping per counterparty; explanation of the production-cycle funding model; and an internal payment-sequencing and beneficiary white-list policy approved by management.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner or significant shareholder qualifies as a politically exposed person (PEP) or is linked to a foreign public authority
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal PEP status declaration; source-of-funds breakdown precisely reconciling the share-capital subscription amount; notarial attestation of the share acquisition; sanctions and PEP screening results; and an enhanced due diligence memorandum from external compliance counsel covering the economic purpose and origin of every inward contribution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-risk exposure along the payment corridor, in particular where raw materials are sourced from or sales are routed via a third-country group treasury
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: External legal opinion on EU, OFAC and UN sanctions coverage of all counterparties; SWIFT sanctions-screening output and adverse-media dashboard; letters of undertaking from the group treasury confirming no sanctioned disbursement routing; and structured MT103 purpose codes in field 70 distinguishing capital injections, trade disbursements and service fees to prevent mixed-purpose false positives.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Special pharmaceutical licence not yet evidenced at account application stage, creating an integrity gap between treasury operating date and regulatory go-live
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ANSM application receipt or pre-notification letter, in-process GMP certification, official confirmation of the ANSM electronic submission, and a management undertaking that commercial-stock treasury disbursements will be activated only after final manufacturing authorisation; together with an ACPR orientation note prepared by regulated French counsel.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound equity or shareholder-loan transfers are executed by SWIFT MT103 in EUR settled on the T2/TARGET2 RTGS platform, with USD legs via the French bank's New York correspondent using CHIPS or Fedwire. Three mandatory compliance layers apply: first, purpose field 70 states the Banque de France nature-of-transaction code for direct investment or shareholder financing (capital increase or long-term shareholder loan) so that balance-of-payments classification is correct; second, the receiving bank verifies the notarised declaration of subscription and payment, the amended statuts, the executed shareholder-loan agreement where applicable, the SARL's Legal Entity Identifier, and UBO screening of the remitting shareholder; third, if the non-EEA shareholder would acquire direct or indirect control of a French biohealth-sector entity, prior authorisation from the Direction Générale du Trésor under Article L.151-3 paragraph IV CMF must be obtained before the transfer is cleared. Funds land in the dedicated blocked or capital-escrow account and are released to the operating account only after issuance of the banker's capital certificate and confirmation that the manufacturing licence gate is satisfied.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound treasury settlements use SWIFT MT103 in EUR via T2/RTGS or in USD via correspondent clearing for consumables, equipment, licensing and service fees; irrevocable commercial letters of credit under UCP600 or eUCP opened for bioreactor raw-material imports and biosimilar export deliveries, with presentation of GMP certificates, certificates of analysis, proforma invoices and transport documents; documentary collection on D/P and D/A terms for low-risk recurring counterparties; and approved supply-chain finance facilities for longer-tenor suppliers. Every outbound instruction above the notification threshold feeds the company's Banque de France balance-of-payments monthly declaration executed through the resident bank, and each payment is checked against the pre-approved beneficiary list and the group sanctions-screening engine before final release.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CNY) hedging binding commercial and capital-expenditure exposures
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (EUR/USD basis) on shareholder loans and equipment financing to eliminate currency mismatches
FX swaps (spot/forward combinations) for temporary conversion of foreign-currency export receivables into operational EUR liquidity
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited to sales or procurement ledger currencies with restricted convertibility or illiquid onshore interbank markets

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (comptes annuels) including management report and auditor's report (if applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registrar of the Commercial Court)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval required within 6 months of fiscal year end; filing within 1 month thereafter, i.e. effectively 7 months from fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year entity, filed by July 31.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may trigger a civil penalty up to €1,500 per month of delay (€4,500 maximum), an additional court order under a daily penalty (astreinte) up to €300/day, and the possibility of administrative strike-off for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale) with electronic financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending December 31, filed by May 3 of the following calendar year (or adjusted to the next business day); for non-calendar fiscal years, within 3 months of the fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a 10% late-payment penalty on assessed tax (40% if not filed within 30 days of a formal notice) plus monthly interest at 0.20% of the tax amount; continued defiance may lead to the company being declared administratively insolvent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners (déclaration annuelle de confirmation des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (integrated into the annual accounts filing procedure)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted simultaneously with the annual accounts filing, i.e. under the same deadline as the annual accounts (effectively by July 31 for calendar-year entities).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission of the annual confirmation may result in a fine up to €15,000 for the legal entity and, for deliberate misstatement, criminal penalties up to 6 months' imprisonment and €7,500 fine for individuals (manifesting the declaration offence).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Statutory auditor's report (rapport du commissaire aux comptes) on the annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders' meeting, then filed with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce as part of the annual accounts dossier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The auditor's report must be communicated to shareholders at least 15 days before the shareholders' meeting approving the accounts; meeting must be held within 6 months of fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint a statutory auditor (when required) or to present the auditor's report to the shareholders renders the annual approval decision null and void; the manager is liable to a fine up to €9,000 and / or imprisonment for 6 months.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SARL must appoint a statutory auditor when it exceeds at least two of the three following thresholds at the end of a fiscal year: total assets > €4 million, turnover (excluding VAT) > €8 million, and average number of employees > 50. In addition, a biopharma manufacturing company holding a special licence (ISIC 2100) is often considered a 'public interest entity' for regulatory purposes, and an audit may be required as a condition of the operating licence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – PCG) in accordance with European Directive 2013/34/EU; an unlisted SARL is not permitted to apply IFRS unless it opts to do so as a 'grande entreprise' or is a subsidiary of an IFRS-listed group. Tax returns must be prepared on the accounting basis used for the statutory financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The annual confirmation of beneficial owners must be submitted even when no shareholding transfer or membership change has occurred during the past year. Any modification in the list of beneficial owners must be declared to the RCS within 30 days of the transaction. The confirmation is performed by filing a specific declaration attached to the annual accounts filing dossier; the same legal obligations apply for any direct or indirect control through, inter alia, voting rights or the right of veto.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors (Registre des Décisions des Gérants)
Minute Book (Registre des Procès-Verbaux d'Assemblées Générales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: €700 – €2,400 (approx. $840 – $2,880) per year, depending on the location (Paris vs. region) and the service level (standard correspondence, tax representative, or virtual office with KYC.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $10,000 – $28,000 for a biopharma manufacturing SARL with revenues around the audit threshold; first-year audit typically includes additional implementation costs of $4,000 – $8,000.

stage_6.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (l'liasse fiscale: main return 2065 plus schedules 2050 to 2058-SD, 2059-A/B and 2069-RCI), e-filed via the impots.gouv.fr professional portal (EFI – Espace Fiscal Professionnel; mandatory EDI/EFI filing for all companies subject to corporate income tax).
stage_6.reporting_frequency: Annual (one return per fiscal year); the financial statements must be filed with the RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés) within 2 months of the shareholders' approval.
stage_6.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December: file online by the 2nd business day after 1 May of the following year (e.g., 5 May 2025 for FY2024); for a year-end other than 31 December: file within 3 months of the fiscal year-end; the 2065 return is due no later than one month after the approval of financial statements if the latter is earlier.
